subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should fallback transition and recovery notices remain visible in direct external chats while being suppressed only in group and channel rooms, or should all external user-facing channels suppress them?
rationale: The existing open report requests an all-external-channel boundary, while this PR intentionally selects a narrower room-only policy; source-level correctness cannot choose that privacy and operator-diagnostics tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt room-only suppression
options.body: Keep direct-chat diagnostics and merge only after live room/direct-chat proof confirms the intended distinction.

options.title: Suppress all external delivery
options.body: Broaden the change so fallback notices remain telemetry only and do not enter any user-facing channel payload.

recommendation.title: Adopt room-only suppression
recommendation.body: Keep direct-chat diagnostics and merge only after live room/direct-chat proof confirms the intended distinction.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fallback lifecycle visibility behavior and are best positioned to confirm its permanent delivery boundary.
